title: getcallinfo
summary: Return deterministic information about the current RunMat call context.
description: `getcallinfo` is an undocumented MATLAB-adjacent compatibility helper. RunMat exposes deterministic call-context metadata for client code that probes it.
behaviors: The result is a scalar struct with `name`, `file`, `line`, and `stack` fields.
`stack` uses the same 1-by-N cell row of frame structs as `dbstack`.

faqs.question: Is `getcallinfo` full MATLAB API compatibility?
faqs.answer: No public MathWorks API contract was used for this helper. RunMat provides stable current-frame and stack metadata for compatibility with code that checks for its existence.

gpu_behavior: `getcallinfo` is host-side call-context introspection and has no GPU/provider behavior.
